'''''Matthiola fruticulosa''''', the '''sad stock''' or '''dark-flowered stock''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Brassicaceae]], native to the Mediterranean region.<ref name="286898-1" >{{cite web |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:286898-1 |title=''Matthiola fruticulosa'' (L.) Maire |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=17 May 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nhm.ac.uk/our-science/data/uk-species/taxon?tvk=NBNSYS0000033902 |title=''Matthiola fruticulosa'' (L.) Maire |last1=Wilkinson |first1=Steve |date=1 January 1999 |website=Species Dictionary |publisher=The Trustees of The Natural History Museum, London |access-date=17 May 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Matthiola fruticulosa'' dark-flowered stock |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/21210/matthiola-fruticulosa/details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=17 May 2021 }}</ref> It is adapted to clay and marl soil types.<ref name="1_of_453_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |title=Effects of Soil Erosion on the Floristic Composition of Plant Communities on Marl in Northeast Spain |last1=Guerrero-Campo |first1=Joaquín |last2=Montserrat-Martí |first2=Gabriel |journal=Journal of Vegetation Science |year=2000 |volume=11 |issue=3 |pages=329–336 |doi=10.2307/3236625 |jstor=3236625 }}</ref>
